items.title: Is Earnings Growth Altering The Investment Case For News (NWSA)?
items.summary: News Corporation reported first quarter results for the period ended September 30, 2026, with sales of US$974 million, total revenue of US$2.281 billion, net income of US$159 million and basic and diluted EPS from continuing operations of US$0.29, all stated as higher than the same quarter a year earlier. The combination of higher sales, greater revenue, increased net income and stronger earnings per share suggests News Corporation’s mix of businesses produced broader operating improvements...
